versions.changelog:
- Removed "Publishing Code from Restricted Networks" section from documentation.
- No functional changes to skill code or rules.
- Documentation now focuses exclusively on safety programming guardrails and checklists.

- Updated publication and network access guidance for restricted environments (formerly "Publishing Code to GitHub from China").
- Instructions now refer to "restricted networks" generically, not just China.
- No other functional or content changes made.

- Updated publication section with new Clawhub URL and workflow reference.
- Added and referenced the new publishing workflow file: references/clawhub-publish.md.
- Updated instructions for pushing to GitHub from China, specifying generic proxy setup and clarifying skill references.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md.
- No changes to checklist logic, safety rules, or technical recommendations.

- Initial release of the safety-programming-checklist skill providing strict guardrails for system-level code modifications.
- Includes 8 iron rules, pre-flight and post-change checklists, and emergency rollback procedures learned from Hermes Desktop crash incidents.
- Details specific rules and workflows for Hermes Desktop environment, including file structure and build/deploy steps.
- Documents rules for safe GitHub publishing from China with proxy configuration and token management.
- Provides incident log mapping previous crashes to violated rules for future prevention.
